data.title: Hans F. Wagner
data.bio: Hans F. Wagner, artist, lives among the Pacific West. He writes, paints, and records music in his studio at Bogus Thunder, shoveling out whorls on a long mesa slanting towards the Isosceles Triangle.
data.showTitle: Hans F. Wagner - Reading and Sound Collage: A Tale of the Ragged Mountains (Poe/Chain), John Zoon (hans f. wagner) & General Baby (jon nielsen) - The Lost Gamma Gulch Tapes
data.showDescription: Guitar collage, sound collage, and language.
